verses.english: Linked Discourses 35.15
2. Pairs
In Search of Gratification (Interior)
“Mendicants, I went in search of the eye’s gratification,
and I found it.

verses.pali: Yāvatā cakkhussa assādo paññāya me so sudiṭṭho.
verses.english: I’ve seen clearly with wisdom the full extent of the eye’s gratification.
I went in search of the eye’s drawback,
and I found it.

verses.pali: Yāvatā cakkhussa ādīnavo paññāya me so sudiṭṭho.
verses.english: I’ve seen clearly with wisdom the full extent of the eye’s drawback.
I went in search of escape from the eye,
and I found it.

verses.pali: Yāvatā cakkhussa nissaraṇaṁ, paññāya me taṁ sudiṭṭhaṁ.
verses.english: I’ve seen clearly with wisdom the full extent of escape from the eye.
I went in search of the ear’s …
nose’s …
tongue’s …

verses.pali: Yāvatā jivhāya assādo paññāya me so sudiṭṭho.
Yāvatā jivhāya ādīnavo paññāya me so sudiṭṭho.
Yāvatā jivhāya nissaraṇaṁ, paññāya me taṁ sudiṭṭhaṁ …pe…
verses.english: body’s …
mind’s gratification,
and I found it.

verses.pali: Yāvatā manassa assādo paññāya me so sudiṭṭho.
verses.english: I’ve seen clearly with wisdom the full extent of the mind’s gratification.
I went in search of the mind’s drawback,
and I found it.

verses.pali: Yāvatā manassa ādīnavo paññāya me so sudiṭṭho.
verses.english: I’ve seen clearly with wisdom the full extent of the mind’s drawback.
I went in search of escape from the mind,
and I found it.

verses.pali: Yāvatā manassa nissaraṇaṁ, paññāya me taṁ sudiṭṭhaṁ.
verses.english: I’ve seen clearly with wisdom the full extent of escape from the mind.

verses.pali: Yāvakīvañcāhaṁ, bhikkhave, imesaṁ channaṁ ajjhattikānaṁ āyatanānaṁ assādañca assādato, ādīnavañca ādīnavato, nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṁ nābbhaññāsiṁ …pe…
verses.english: As long as I didn’t truly understand these six interior sense fields’ gratification, drawback, and escape for what they are, I didn’t announce my supreme perfect awakening …
But when I did truly understand …
Knowledge and vision arose in me:

verses.pali: ‘akuppā me vimutti, ayamantimā jāti, natthi dāni punabbhavo’”ti.
verses.english: ‘My freedom is unshakable; this is my last rebirth; now there’ll be no more future lives.’”
